comments.text: Extracted CommandWorkerFargateService construct (dashboard/amplify/command-service/worker-service.ts) from CommandServiceStack's inline Fargate/ECS/IAM logic. CommandServiceStack now composes it; existing resource.test.ts (20 tests) still green unchanged. Also threaded configurable visibilityTimeout into TaskStreamDispatcher (was hardcoded 12h) so callers with shorter lease/heartbeat needs get a matching SQS visibility timeout.
